summary.text: The match ended in a draw after BRD scored 355 all out in their first innings, led by Dhruv Patel with 124 runs off 267 balls, while Kartik Yadav took 5 for 104. UP responded with 492 all out, featuring Adarsh Singh who scored 162 off 276 balls against Mahesh Pithiya's bowling figures of 6 for 116. In their second innings, BRD finished on 169 for 6 as Dhruv Patel again top-scored with 42 off 140 balls, while Prashant Veer claimed 3 for 42.
